posts.subject: Doo Doo :)
posts.bodyHtml:
Well where should I start Doo Doo?
I want to thank you soo much man you have been with me for such a long time you have been supporting me with my ups and downs, you have been answering my most stupid questions, you have took care of me when I was worried or was kind scared about something, Doo Doo you have been a pleasure to work with and you gave me great fun during the Knife server fun like Hostage or Deatmatch the work you have put into the server is incredable the time you spend on that server is just amazing of course sometimes you even helped me with handle abuse towards me with that test thank you for that as you wanted to see if I changed, The time we spoken together via Steam or Whatsapp, You have made me laugh most of the times with some stuff that you sended me, Sometimes you leave me speachless after what amout of amazing work you do and promise to do it's just plain amazing dude.
I just want to thank you from bottom of my [<3] for sticking up with and for me in most ocasions, you are just AWESOME keep it going and sure you will uprank into Admin+ soon with the effort you giving us.




Kind Regards


Michal "OxygeN" J.

Omg Oxygennnn :'DDD


Bro, I appreciate it, try my hardest to make this the best community it can be and helping people along the way is just compulsory for me 😄


You've actually changed so much, from the old, toxic, flaming, "banter"-rous Oxygen to the nice, controlled, helpful Oxygen 😄


I guess we all need some "Oxygen" in our lives [;)]


Thank you again! I appreciate everything and I honestly wish you the best and hope that you can do the same thing as I did!


"Kindness causes an endless ripple, that comes back to you"


Doo Doo

no problem doo doo you deserved this soo bad, you are the most helpful guy ever that I could meet keep it up and have OxygeN [;)]


Kind Regards


Michal "OxygeN" J.
